d:
Healthy Breakfast Atta Veg Rolls, sabjiyon se labalab bhare hue, sopht aur testi, School Tiffin ke lie aasan resipi, morning brekphast ke lie parphekt, bina maida, kam tel men banne vala yah nashta. nashte men kuchh heldi chahie? to ye aata vej rol traee kijie
Ingredients for Veg Rolls
Gehun ka aata - Wheat Flour - 2 cup (250g)
Namak - Salt - 1 tsp
Ajvain - Carom Seeds - ¼ tsp
Beking soda - Baking Soda - ⅛ tsp
Ghi - Ghee - 4 tbsp
Shimla mirch - Capsicum - ½ cup (chopped)
